notes: Invader-deck stack per adversary and level. Levels are keyed by adversary level 0-6 (not difficulty) and are cumulative: level N applies every deck change from levels 1..N. stack_sequence lists Invader card stages from top (first revealed, including the Setup Explore card) to bottom; named Stage II cards (C = Coastal Lands, S = Salt Deposits) count as 2. deck_order uses the panels' 'New Deck Order' notation; R marks the Habsburg Reminder Card, which is not an Invader card. notation keeps '3 · 4 · 5' for the base deck so saved games on an unchanged deck are not re-migrated. Source: each level's deck_recipe text in the Steam engine defs and register.md section 4; difficulty is the box value.
